title: erythrina abyssinica subsp. suberifera
intro: Erythrina abyssinica subsp. suberifera, commonly known as the red acacia or red coral tree, is a deciduous tree species native to tropical Africa. The plant has been traditionally used in various cultures for its medicinal properties, including its potential to treat fever, cough, and respiratory infections, due to its health benefits. Its therapeutic actions include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant activities, which can help in reducing inflammation and fighting off infections. The bioactive constituents of Erythrina abyssinica subsp. suberifera include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties and health benefits.
